Electric boilers operating at pressures or temperatures classified as high-pressure boilers, as defined in the New York city mechanical code, shall be annually inspected as high-pressure boilers in accordance with this article.
(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 1/1/2022; Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126 and L.L. 2023/077.
